articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) today announced the acquisition of Trowbridge Crossing, a 62,600 square foot center anchored by Publix in Sandy Springs, Georgia, for $11 million. This press release features multimedia.
